narr: An upper low continued to meander across the region on June 9, 2021. Weak upper-level disturbances rotated around the upper low and interacted with a very moist air mass across the Mid-South to produce several rounds of heavy rain across East-Central Arkansas and North Mississippi. There were several instances of flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding across Lee County. Several roads were flooded and 18 houses were impacted.

Heavy rain caused flash flooding across Lafayette County. Four homes and six businesses were impacted. There was flooding at Old Sardis Road, Turnberry Circle, Hathorn Road near Jackson Road, and County Road 317. In total 14 roads were impacted by flooding.
Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding across Chickasaw County. Ten roads were flooded.
State Route 330 near Tillatoba Lake is flooded.
Highway 51 flooded just south of Como.
Part of a bridge washed out on Stark Road.
Significant flooding at Highway 4 and House Road. House Road was closed.
